gk.footer: Green Key Readiness is a Triple i preparation tool. Green Key is a programme of the Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE); Triple i is not affiliated with or endorsed by FEE. Criteria titles and guidance here are Triple i paraphrases, not the official criteria text.

guideline.label: Guideline criteria
guideline.transitionLine: Transition rule applied (re-applicant from 2022–2026, until {date}): next lower percentage.
guideline.dispensationLine: One-period dispensation recorded — confirm its effect with the certification body.
guideline.counts: {met} of {total} applicable guideline criteria met; {needed} needed.

portfolio.title: Green Key Readiness portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: All clients and establishments at a glance.
portfolio.intro: Green Key Readiness helps you prepare establishments for Green Key certification: applicable criteria, evidence, monthly resource data, carbon and the audit lifecycle. Each establishment is the certifiable unit.
portfolio.noKpis: No KPI data yet — enter resource and occupancy data.

clients.title: Clients & establishments
clients.subtitle: Hotel groups, owners and operators, their brands and establishments.
clients.name: Client name
clients.empty: No clients yet. Create your first client to add establishments.
clients.confirmDelete: Delete client {name} with all its establishments and data?
clients.confirmDeleteBrand: Delete brand {name}? Establishments keep their data.
clients.branchRule: One establishment per permanent location: a branch at a different address is a separate establishment with its own application, audit, certificate and data. Several buildings on one site stay one establishment.

profile.name: Establishment name
profile.countryHint: 2-letter code (AM, GE, BE…). Used for national adaptations and the grid factor.
profile.employeesHint: Several criteria change above 50 employees (more targets and actions; some criteria become imperative).
profile.categoryCheck: Category check: the Hotels & Hostels eligibility thresholds are not configured yet. Confirm the category with the certification body.
profile.priorPeriodsHint: 0 for a first-time applicant. The certificate history also counts.
profile.transitionHint: Until 31 Dec 2027: next lower guideline percentage, and six months of data instead of two calendar years.
profile.dispensation: One-period dispensation confirmed by the certification body
profile.confirmDelete: Delete {name} and all its data and evidence?
profile.noApplicabilityChange: Profile saved. The applicable criteria did not change.

criteria.title: Title (paraphrased)
criteria.subtitle: Versioned criteria with paraphrased guidance, applicability rules and evidence expectations.
criteria.starterNote: Starter set: only the criteria named in the product specification are seeded (1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.6, 1.9, 1.10, 1.20, 1.21, 2.5, 3.1), with provisional types. Complete the library for your workspace by adding or importing criteria — paraphrase, never copy the official text.
criteria.paraphraseRule: Write short paraphrases in your own words. Do not paste the official Green Key criteria text.
criteria.guidanceHint: Short, practical, in your own words.
criteria.applicabilityHint: Keys: minEmployees, maxEmployees, requiresFacility, excludesFacility, notSeasonal, seasonalOnly, countries, excludeCountries, typeByEmployees {threshold, above, atOrBelow}, naAllowedWithJustification, evidenceMaxAgeMonths, reviewEveryMonths.
criteria.badJson: The text is not valid JSON.
criteria.noneInArea: No criteria loaded for this area yet.
criteria.overrideHint: Create your own version of this criterion; it replaces the starter entry in your workspace.
criteria.importHelp: Paste or load a CSV with a header row ({cols}) or a JSON array of criteria. Existing criteria in your library with the same version and code are updated; nothing is imported if any row is invalid.

board.definition: Readiness % = applicable criteria that are approved or conform, or marked not applicable with a justification, divided by all applicable criteria. Imperative gaps = imperative criteria not yet done. Guideline achieved % = guideline criteria approved or conforming ÷ applicable guideline criteria (justified N/A removed).
board.paraphrased: Paraphrased guidance — check the official criteria before the audit.
board.naAllowedHint: This criterion may be marked N/A with a stored justification (e.g. assessment result).

evidence.linkHint: Linking moves Not started / In progress criteria to Evidence uploaded.
evidence.allowed: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, DOCX, XLSX · max 20 MB
evidence.reviewHelp: Approving moves linked criteria with status Evidence uploaded to Approved.
evidence.adminOnly: Evidence approval is done by an administrator (consultant).

data.coverageHelp: Criterion 3.1: monthly water records per source for the last two calendar years; first-time applicants need the previous full year or at least three months; during the transition six months are enough. The same check is shown for energy, waste and occupancy.

rule.firstTime: First-time: previous full year or ≥ 3 months

data.notesHint: Document how the value was measured or estimated.
data.occupancyBoth: Enter both guest nights and occupied room-nights for each month.

gridHelp.energy: Monthly consumption per energy source; pick the unit in the column header. Values convert to kWh with the shared Triple i factors.
gridHelp.water: Monthly water per source in m³. Non-public sources (well, surface) need permit evidence.
gridHelp.waste: Monthly waste per stream and disposal route in kg.
gridHelp.occupancy: Guest nights and occupied room-nights per month (from your PMS).

data.importHelp: One row per month and source. Columns:
data.importColKind: kind: energy, water, waste or occupancy.
data.importColSource: source: energy source (electricity, natural_gas, district_heat, district_cool, lpg, biomass, oil), water source (municipal, well, surface, rainwater, tanker) or waste stream (mixed, paper, plastic, glass, metal, organic, hazardous, other).
data.importColUnit: unit: energy kWh/MWh/m3/Gcal/litre/kg as allowed for the source; water m3 or litre; waste kg or t. disposal (waste only): landfill, recycled, composted, incinerated.
data.importColEstimated: estimated: yes/no; estimationMethod: area_allocation, occupancy_allocation, tank_refills, delivery_logs, other.
data.importColOccupancy: Occupancy rows: kind=occupancy with guestNights and occupiedRooms (room-nights).
data.importReplace: A row for an existing month and source replaces the stored value. Nothing is imported if any row is invalid.
data.imported: Imported {r} resource rows and {o} occupancy months.

kpis.method: Scope 1–2 location-based, from the energy data with the shared Triple i factors and the country of the establishment. Market-based Scope 2 is not included in this version.
kpis.biogenic: Biogenic CO₂ from wood/biomass reported separately: {n} t.
kpis.estimatedShare: {n}% of records in the period are estimated.

plan.intro: Rules from criteria 1.2 and 1.3 are checked as you build. This establishment has {n} employees (more than 50 → at least 4 targets and 4 actions; otherwise 2).

actions.timeline: Each action has a due date
actions.linkedTarget: Each action linked to a target
actions.unfulfilled: Unfulfilled actions justified, with next step

people.runningYear: The current year is still running: missing items show as Due, not Fail.
people.name: Name
people.replaceCurrent: Replace the current holder of this role
people.replaceHint: The current person's term ends on the start date; history is kept.
people.trainingHelp: At least two briefings a year (one if seasonal or 5 staff or fewer), one general and one departmental training a year, and new hires trained within 4 weeks of starting.
people.hireHint: Training should be within 4 weeks of this date.

audit.packNote: The audit pack export (button at the top) is an XLSX with one sheet per area, N/A justifications, evidence file names and dates, resource data, KPIs, targets, actions, team and training. A ZIP of evidence files is not included in this version.
audit.followUp: {n} non-conformities at one audit — follow-up audit required
audit.ncRule: 1–5 non-conformities: send evidence within two months. More than 5 at one audit: a follow-up audit is required.

certs.title: Certificates
certs.subtitle: All certificates across establishments, with surveillance and renewal timers.
certs.rules: Certificates are valid 24 months. Surveillance visit window: 8–14 months after certification. Contact the certification body about renewal 6–8 months before expiry. A suspended certificate must not be displayed.

overview.readinessDef: Done = approved, conforms, or N/A with justification.
overview.noTasks: Nothing due in the next month.
